::: {.callout-tip}
## Open the planner
**[obwb.shinyapps.io/ubco-freshwater-planner/](https://obwb.shinyapps.io/ubco-freshwater-planner/){target="_blank"}**

The planner reads the live UBC Okanagan course catalogue and the curated
PAg and RPBio designation mappings from this site. Tick the courses you
have completed (or transferred in), pick one or both designation goals,
and it reports your progress against the degree and the designations in
real time.
:::

# What the planner does

Set two things in the sidebar, your **target designations** (PAg, RPBio,
or both) and your **current year in the program**, then work through the
tabs:

- **Step 1, tick completed courses.** Each year is an accordion panel
  listing the curated recommended courses first, with an "other
  Y*nnn*-level courses" selector for anything off the default path. A
  separate search box handles transfer credits and courses not surfaced
  in the year panels.
- **Board, years side-by-side.** Your plan as a five-column board (one
  column per year). Cards fill solid when ticked and stay outlined when
  not, a scannable read of where you are across the whole degree.
- **Map, prerequisite graph.** A `visNetwork` graph of roughly 70 core
  and recommended courses, arrows pointing from a prerequisite to the
  course that needs it, nodes coloured by level and filled when ticked.
  Hover any node for its full title and its prerequisites from the live
  UBC Okanagan Academic Calendar.
- **Suggestions, gaps and next steps.** Prerequisite-gap warnings for
  courses you have ticked but seem to be missing a foundation, plus a
  curated list of courses you could realistically register for next term
  given what you have already cleared.
- **Step 2, credit and degree summary.** How you sit against the degree
  thresholds (120 credits / 78 Science / 42 upper-level / 36 upper-level
  Science), with a table of everything you have ticked.
- **Step 3, designation gap analysis.** PAg category coverage (8
  foundational plus 20 agrology with at least 8 senior) and RPBio
  coverage (6 core areas, the three-of-five subject areas, and the
  13-biology count), with an **exportable plan** you can print or save as
  a PDF to bring to an advising appointment.

You can also **save your plan to a file** and reload it next session, or
email it to the program advisor before a meeting (sidebar, "Save / load
plan").

::: {.callout-important}
## Read the results as guidance, not a verdict
The planner is an advising aid. UBC's prerequisite strings are
natural-language ("either (a) X or (b) all of Y and Z"), and the planner
collapses them into a flat code list, so treat prerequisite arrows and
gap flags as a guide rather than a plan-validator. **Always confirm your
degree plan with the program advisor and the
[UBC Okanagan Academic Calendar](https://okanagan.calendar.ubc.ca/),
which remains authoritative.**
:::
